thread.title: TD Ameritrade Stock Up As Earnings Beat; Interactive Brokers Misses |

author: APARNA NARAYANAN
title: TD Ameritrade Stock Up As Earnings Beat; Interactive Brokers Misses |
text:
TD Ameritrade ( AMTD ) earnings topped forecasts while Interactive Brokers ( IBKR ) fell short, a week after rival online broker Charles Schwab ( SCHW ) beat estimates. TD Ameritrade stock rallied late.
X
TD Ameritrade Earnings Estimates : TD Ameritrade earnings to climb 25% to $1 a share on revenue growth of 17% to $1.47 billion, according to Zacks Investment Research
Results : EPS of $1.11 on revenue of $1.52 billion. Net new client assets grew 10% to $32 billion. Average client trades per day climbed 28% to approximately 928,000. Average mobile trades per day jumped more than 50% to 240,000.
"Investor sentiment shifted in the quarter as anxiety and macroeconomic uncertainty started moving the markets, underscoring the importance of our client-centric value proposition," said CEO Tim Hockey.
TD Ameritrade stock rose 1.9% late after closing down 0.8% at 54.92 on the stock market today , pulling back below its 200-day line after topping it intraday.
Watch for the stock, which has been under the 200-day line for more than four months, to decisively clear that key support level.
Meanwhile, TD Ameritrade stock has a rising relative strength line, which tracks a stock's performance against the S&P 500, and recently retook its 50-day moving average.
This IBD 50 stock earns a superior IBD Composite Rating of 98, in part due to strong earnings and sales acceleration in the past two years. But analysts see EPS growth slowing to 17% in 2019 and to 8% in 2020.
TD Ameritrade continues to lead fintech innovation. It announced an industry-first service a week ago: the ability for individual investors to instantly fund a brokerage account with Apple Pay through Apple Business Chat in the Messages app on Apple ( AAPL ) iPhoneS and iPads.
 Interactive Brokers Earnings Estimates : Interactive Brokers earnings to jump 37% to 59 cents a share despite sales slipping 3% to $497 million.
Results : EPS of 57 cents on revenue of $492 million. Interest income revenue increased 36.5% to $385 million. Commissions revenue rose 20.6% to $205 million. Trading revenue totaled $7 million, down 50%.
Interactive Brokers was hurt by its currency diversification strategy, which swung to a $12 million loss vs. a $6 million gain in the year-ago quarter.
Customer accounts increased 24% to 598,000, and total daily average revenue trades increased 30% to 951,000.
Interactive Brokers stock fell 0.9% late after closing down 4.9% to at 51.95 Tuesday, putting it back below the 50-day line. The stock has an IBD Composite Rating of 71. Analysts foresee earnings growth of 20% in 2019 after a scorching 40% pace in 2018.
Online Broker See Rise Of Free Investing Apps Charles Schwab beat expectations last Wednesday as net interest revenue and trading revenue jumped in Q4. Daily average trades surged 38% for Schwab, but average revenue per trade fell 3%.
E-Trade Financial ( ETFC ) earnings follow on Thursday.
Shares of online brokers including Charles Schwab tumbled in 2018 after JPMorgan Chase ( JPM ) announced a free investing app .
